quote: The lovely thing about being forty is that you can appreciate twenty-five-year-old men more.
author: Colleen McCullough

quote: Whatever you may look like, marry a man your own age - as your beauty fades, so will his eyesight.
author: Phyllis Diller

quote: Have regular hours for work and play make each day both useful and pleasant, and prove that you understand the worth of time by employing it well. Then youth will be delightful, old age will bring few regrets, and life will become a beautiful success.
author: Louisa May Alcott

quote: But an old age serene and bright, and lovely as a Lapland night, shall lead thee to thy grave.
author: William Wordsworth

quote: A bad manner spoils everything, even reason and justice a good one supplies everything, gilds a No, sweetens a truth, and adds a touch of beauty to old age itself.
author: Baltasar Gracian

quote: Our scientific age demands that we provide definitions, measurements, and statistics in order to be taken seriously. Yet most of the important things in life cannot be precisely defined or measured. Can we define or measure love, beauty, friendship, or decency, for example?
author: Dennis Prager

quote: What could be more beautiful than a dear old lady growing wise with age? Every age can be enchanting, provided you live within it.
author: Brigitte Bardot

quote: Every age yearns for a more beautiful world. The deeper the desperation and the depression about the confusing present, the more intense that yearning.
author: Johan Huizinga

quote: I think it's your mental attitude. So many of us start dreading age in high school and that's a waste of a lovely life. 'Oh... I'm 30, oh, I'm 40, oh, 50.' Make the most of it.
author: Betty White

quote: I want to be part of the resurgence of things that are tangible, beautiful and soulful, rather than just give in to the digital age. But when I talk to people about this they just say, 'Yeah, I know what you mean,' and stare at their mobiles.
author: Jack White

quote: I'm very accepting with my age. It's like notches on your belt: experience, wisdom, and a different kind of beauty. There comes a day when you've become comfortable in your skin.
author: Zoe Saldana

quote: People pay to see movies with women looking beautiful, but I think there will be a place for me to play women looking my own age.
author: Debra Winger

quote: For the moment I prefer to be a beautiful woman of my age than try desperately to look 30.
author: Demi Moore

quote: I envy the sensibility in Europe, appreciating beauty in women as they age. I'm going to go that way. I might dye my gray hair for a bit, but beyond that the buck stops. I'm not having any work done.
author: Rachel Bilson

quote: Childhood itself is scarcely more lovely than a cheerful, kindly, sunshiny old age.
author: Lydia M. Child

quote: What a lovely surprise to finally discover how unlonely being alone can be.
author: Ellen Burstyn

quote: For beautiful eyes, look for the good in others for beautiful lips, speak only words of kindness and for poise, walk with the knowledge that you are never alone.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: The soul that sees beauty may sometimes walk alone.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: Children, dear and loving children, can alone console a woman for the loss of her beauty.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: Death is the mother of Beauty hence from her, alone, shall come fulfillment to our dreams and our desires.
author: Wallace Stevens

quote: In Sleep we lie all naked and alone, in Sleep we are united at the heart of night and darkness, and we are strange and beautiful asleep for we are dying the darkness and we know no death.
author: Thomas Wolfe

quote: That we find a crystal or a poppy beautiful means that we are less alone, that we are more deeply inserted into existence than the course of a single life would lead us to believe.
author: John Berger

quote: Surely being a Professional Beauty - let alone an ageing one - is one of the most insecure and doomed careers imaginable.
author: Julie Burchill

quote: 'Tis the last rose of summer Left blooming alone All her lovely companions Are faded and gone.
author: Thomas More

quote: The development of beauty in chess never depends on you alone. No matter how much imagination and creativity you invest, you still do not create beauty. Your opponent must react at the same highest level.
author: Vladimir Kramnik

quote: People must feel that the natural world is important and valuable and beautiful and wonderful and an amazement and a pleasure.
author: David Attenborough

quote: It is amazing how complete is the delusion that beauty is goodness.
author: Leo Tolstoy

quote: One of the most amazing things about mathematics is the people who do math aren't usually interested in application, because mathematics itself is truly a beautiful art form. It's structures and patterns, and that's what we love, and that's what we get off on.
author: Danica McKellar

quote: It's an amazing thing to say, 'I'm beautiful,' without feeling like you're cocky.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: I hope I'm not a tourist attraction - I'm sure that they come here really because St. Andrews is just amazing, a beautiful place.
author: Prince William

quote: I saw 'The Artist.' It's really beautiful and it's all done to the letter with all the silent film techniques. The costumes were amazing and the dog is so good.
author: Florence Welch

quote: I love a beautiful gown on stage, and luckily I've been fortunate to wear some amazing dresses.
author: Leona Lewis

quote: I get such lovely gifts from fans... amazing pictures, handmade jewellery. I'm very lucky!
author: Leona Lewis

quote: I decided to give acting a serious, committed try, and soon after, I read the script for 'Lovely and Amazing.' The story was beautiful and honest, and the characters struggled with the same insecurities many women - including me - face. I didn't think I had a chance in hell of being in the film, but I knew I had to go for it.
author: Emily Mortimer

quote: I go to Saint Barth in the French West Indies for two weeks each year. That place is amazing. Amazing people, beautiful beaches, great wine, wonderful harbors... It's incredibly romantic.
author: Brooke Burke

quote: The difference between Marilyn Monroe and the early Pamela Anderson is not that great. What's amazing is that the taste of American men and international tastes in terms of beauty have essentially stayed the same. Styles change, but our view of beauty stays the same.
author: Hugh Hefner

quote: Comics are so full of amazing work. And I can't look at a drawing of a woman without thinking of, for instance, Wallace Wood and his amazing way of capturing beauty.
author: Frank Miller

quote: Elle MacPherson is absolutely amazing she is just so beautiful.
author: Carol Alt

quote: Big dress, cocktails, party - I love that. It is my work, but my work allow me to have glamour, to wear beautiful and amazing dresses, to go to big ceremonies.
author: Paz Vega

quote: Hawaii was beautiful of course, we played at Turtle Bay an amazing resort right on the ocean.
author: Natalie Gulbis

quote: I am married to the most amazing, generous and beautiful human being and it has been hard on him because from the outside if you look at it it's just all about me.
author: Emily Watson

quote: As an editor, I read Charlotte Rogan's amazing debut novel, 'The Lifeboat,' when it was still in manuscript. I read it in one night, and I really wanted my company to publish it, but we lost it to another house. It's such a wonderful combination of beautiful writing and suspenseful storytelling.
author: Karen Thompson Walker

quote: Los Angeles is a very magical place when you take the entertainment industry out of it. You have beautiful beaches and amazing mountains here. I'm a big rock climber. I head out into the mountains whenever I have free time. It's amazing.
author: Alex Pettyfer

quote: There is a film called 'A Separation.' If you see it playing, go see it. It's beautiful. It's so well written and the acting is amazing. It's one of those films that you would love to be a part of.
author: Demian Bichir

quote: Listen, a cable series is a beautiful thing because there's such amazing writing happening on television, and it's a schedule that allows you to do a play or two. There's a reason everybody wants that job!
author: Lily Rabe

quote: You can muck around with different guitars for certain bits, but you have to have your own sound. That's your benchmark, that's your sound. I also play a Black Beauty. It sounds amazing.
author: Dan Hawkins

quote: Turns out, I couldn't catch them - or even get close to them. I realized that sharks are amazing, beautiful animals who have absolutely no interest in checking me out.
author: Malin Akerman

quote: Everyone says, 'You give birth, you go home, and you have this amazing baby and it's just beautiful'. And I walked in and I just started sobbing.
author: Bridget Moynahan

quote: I know no subject more elevating, more amazing, more ready to the poetical enthusiasm, the philosophical reflection, and the moral sentiment than the works of nature. Where can we meet such variety, such beauty, such magnificence?
author: James Thomson

quote: I think 'Game of Thrones' was extraordinary. I want to do some period pieces. It would be lovely to tell great stories, that is my main ambition. And to be working with amazing creators.
author: Stana Katic

quote: There are amazing schools and amazing educators that are doing a wonderful job. And then there are a lot of educators that are not prepared to deal with inclusive education. They haven't been trained. It's really quite lovely and easy when you understand how to do it.
author: Laura San Giacomo

quote: I always knew that St. Jude was an amazing organization but meeting the kids and seeing how the hospital works first hand was truly beautiful. It doesn't feel like a regular hospital all dreary and sad. It's a colorful, beautiful, comfortable, fun place to live and the energy is wonderful.
author: Ariana Grande

quote: I got a phone call from Fearne Cotton. It was amazing! I literally couldn't believe it. It was so cool. It was the night before I was going on her show to sing on the 'Live Lounge.' She was so lovely.
author: Birdy

quote: Obviously, there's the seedy side of the strip club world and pole dancing. But, pole dancing, as an art form, is really beautiful. It's been hyper-sexualized because it's associated with strippers, but if you think about it, just in terms of other kinds of dancing, they're using an instrument to create these amazing dance forms.
author: Megalyn Echikunwoke

quote: It's a joke to think that anyone is one thing. We're all such complex creatures. But if I'm going to be a poster child for anything, anger's a gorgeous emotion. It gets a bad rap, but it can make great changes happen.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: The Anger Management Tour was another beautiful thing. I loved that tour.
author: Obie Trice

quote: There is no more lovely, friendly and charming relationship, communion or company than a good marriage.
author: Martin Luther

quote: Next month, I will celebrate my 30th anniversary of marriage with my beautiful bride, Vicki. Our marriage has been a blessing. I have gained even more respect for the institution over the past 3 decades and will defend it against attack.
author: Todd Tiahrt

quote: To me, a building - if it's beautiful - is the love of one man, he's made it out of his love for space, materials, things like that.
author: Martha Graham

quote: It is not the beauty of a building you should look at its the construction of the foundation that will stand the test of time.
author: David Allan Coe

quote: Proportions are what makes the old Greek temples classic in their beauty. They are like huge blocks, from which the air has been literally hewn out between the columns.
author: Arne Jacobsen

quote: Architecture is not an inspirational business, it's a rational procedure to do sensible and hopefully beautiful things that's all.
author: Harry Seidler

quote: The terrifying and edible beauty of Art Nouveau architecture.
author: Salvador Dali

quote: It is impossible, as impossible as to raise the dead, to restore anything that has ever been great or beautiful in architecture. That which I have insisted upon as the life of the whole, that spirit which is given only by the hand and eye of the workman, can never be recalled.
author: John Ruskin

quote: Maybe we can show government how to operate better as a result of better architecture. Eventually, I think Chicago will be the most beautiful great city left in the world.
author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quote: Chicago is known for good steaks, expensive stores and beautiful architecture. Unfortunately, the Windy City also enjoys a reputation for corrupt politics, violent crime, and some of the strictest gun control laws anywhere in the country.
author: Bob Barr

quote: Every one who has a heart, however ignorant of architecture he may be, feels the transcendent beauty and poetry of the mediaeval churches.
author: Goldwin Smith

quote: What's fascinating about D.C., the exteriors are these elaborate structures, this gorgeous architecture and beautiful stonework, and then you go inside and it's crap-looking - apart from the White House, which is beautiful.
author: Tony Hale

quote: First, there is the bare beauty of the logs themselves with their long lines and firm curves. Then there is the open charm felt of the structural features which are not hidden under plaster and ornament, but are clearly revealed, a charm felt in Japanese architecture.
author: Gustav Stickley

quote: The essence of all beautiful art, all great art, is gratitude.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quote: The sculptor produces the beautiful statue by chipping away such parts of the marble block as are not needed - it is a process of elimination.
author: Elbert Hubbard

quote: Every human is an artist. The dream of your life is to make beautiful art.
author: Miguel Angel Ruiz

quote: Art consists of limitation. The most beautiful part of every picture is the frame.
author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quote: Art produces ugly things which frequently become more beautiful with time. Fashion, on the other hand, produces beautiful things which always become ugly with time.
author: Jean Cocteau

quote: The terrifying and edible beauty of Art Nouveau architecture.
author: Salvador Dali

quote: Things are beautiful if you love them.
author: Jean Anouilh

quote: The moment you cheat for the sake of beauty, you know you're an artist.
author: David Hockney

quote: The beauty one can find in art is one of the pitifully few real and lasting products of human endeavor.
author: Paul Getty

quote: Art is the unceasing effort to compete with the beauty of flowers - and never succeeding.
author: Gian Carlo Menotti

quote: Beauty in art is often nothing but ugliness subdued.
author: Jean Rostand

quote: When I think of art I think of beauty. Beauty is the mystery of life. It is not in the eye it is in the mind. In our minds there is awareness of perfection.
author: Agnes Martin

quote: It is art that makes life, makes interest, makes importance and I know of no substitute whatever for the force and beauty of its process.
author: Max Eastman

quote: Art ought never to be considered except in its relations with its ideal beauty.
author: Alfred de Vigny

quote: The most beautiful thing we can experience is the mysterious. It is the source of all true art and science.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: Love of beauty is taste. The creation of beauty is art.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Art is the beautiful way of doing things. Science is the effective way of doing things. Business is the economic way of doing things.
author: Elbert Hubbard

quote: Art is not the application of a canon of beauty but what the instinct and the brain can conceive beyond any canon. When we love a woman we don't start measuring her limbs.
author: Pablo Picasso

quote: Art can never exist without naked beauty displayed.
author: William Blake

quote: I think having land and not ruining it is the most beautiful art that anybody could ever want to own.
author: Andy Warhol

quote: It is the addition of strangeness to beauty that constitutes the romantic character in art.
author: Walter Hagen

quote: O, thou art fairer than the evening air clad in the beauty of a thousand stars.
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: People who don't like me talk about it as though I'm trash because I have tattoos. I find that insane because it's 2008, not the 1950s. Tattoos aren't limited to sailors. It's a form of art I find beautiful. I love it.
author: Megan Fox

quote: It is art that makes life, makes interest, makes importance... and I know of no substitute whatever for the force and beauty of its process.
author: Henry James

quote: Men's magazines often feature pictures of naked ladies. Women's magazines also often feature pictures of naked ladies. This is because the female body is a beautiful work of art, while the male body is hairy and lumpy and should not be seen by the light of day.
author: Richard Roeper

quote: Courtesy is a silver lining around the dark clouds of civilization it is the best part of refinement and in many ways, an art of heroic beauty in the vast gallery of man's cruelty and baseness.
author: Bryant H. McGill

quote: In life, as in art, the beautiful moves in curves.
author: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

quote: Art is the most beautiful deception of all. And although people try to incorporate the everyday events of life in it, we must hope that it will remain a deception lest it become a utilitarian thing, sad as a factory.
author: Claude Debussy

quote: One of the most amazing things about mathematics is the people who do math aren't usually interested in application, because mathematics itself is truly a beautiful art form. It's structures and patterns, and that's what we love, and that's what we get off on.
author: Danica McKellar

quote: Poetry is a beautiful way of spoiling prose, and the laborious art of exchanging plain sense for harmony.
author: Horace Walpole

quote: I'm very happy to hear that my work inspires writers and painters. It's the most beautiful compliment, the greatest reward. Art should always be an exchange.
author: Nick Cave

quote: The 1990s, after the reign of terror of academic vandalism, will be a decade of restoration: restoration of meaning, value, beauty, pleasure, and emotion to art and restoration of art to its audience.
author: Camille Paglia

quote: Fashion often starts off beautiful and becomes ugly, whereas art starts off ugly sometimes and becomes beautiful.
author: David Bailey

quote: What matters poverty? What matters anything to him who is enamoured of our art? Does he not carry in himself every joy and every beauty?
author: Sarah Bernhardt

quote: I'm not dead and I don't have blue hair but some people say there are similarities. It is usually intolerable to watch myself onscreen but this time it's fine. I think it's beautiful and a real work of art.
author: Helena Bonham Carter

quote: It has taken me years of struggle, hard work and research to learn to make one simple gesture, and I know enough about the art of writing to realize that it would take as many years of concentrated effort to write one simple, beautiful sentence.
author: Isadora Duncan

quote: Be sure what you want and be sure about yourself. Fashion is not just beauty, it's about good attitude. You have to believe in yourself and be strong.
author: Adriana Lima

quote: Always keep that happy attitude. Pretend that you are holding a beautiful fragrant bouquet.
author: Earl Nightingale

quote: I think it's your mental attitude. So many of us start dreading age in high school and that's a waste of a lovely life. 'Oh... I'm 30, oh, I'm 40, oh, 50.' Make the most of it.
author: Betty White

quote: I think one of the things that language poets are very involved with is getting away from conventional ideas of beauty, because those ideas contain a certain attitude toward women, certain attitudes toward sex, certain attitudes toward race, etc.
author: Diane Wakoski

quote: Everything has beauty, but not everyone sees it.
author: Confucius

quote: To love beauty is to see light.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: Beauty is only skin deep. If you go after someone just because she's beautiful but don't have anything to talk about, it's going to get boring fast. You want to look beyond the surface and see if you can have fun or if you have anything in common with this person.
author: Amanda Peet

quote: A woman whose smile is open and whose expression is glad has a kind of beauty no matter what she wears.
author: Anne Roiphe

quote: People are like stained - glass windows. They sparkle and shine when the sun is out, but when the darkness sets in, their true beauty is revealed only if there is a light from within.
author: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

quote: The pursuit of truth and beauty is a sphere of activity in which we are permitted to remain children all our lives.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: Of life's two chief prizes, beauty and truth, I found the first in a loving heart and the second in a laborer's hand.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Love of beauty is taste. The creation of beauty is art.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Life is full of beauty. Notice it. Notice the bumble bee, the small child, and the smiling faces. Smell the rain, and feel the wind. Live your life to the fullest potential, and fight for your dreams.
author: Ashley Smith

quote: A thing of beauty is a joy forever: its loveliness increases it will never pass into nothingness.
author: John Keats

quote: Beauty is eternity gazing at itself in a mirror.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: A beauty is a woman you notice a charmer is one who notices you.
author: Adlai E. Stevenson

quote: The soul that sees beauty may sometimes walk alone.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: Flowers... are a proud assertion that a ray of beauty outvalues all the utilities of the world.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: She got her looks from her father. He's a plastic surgeon.
author: Groucho Marx

quote: Beauty and folly are old companions.
author: Benjamin Franklin

quote: Rare is the union of beauty and purity.
author: Juvenal

quote: Personal beauty is a greater recommendation than any letter of reference.
author: Aristotle

quote: Beauty is unbearable, drives us to despair, offering us for a minute the glimpse of an eternity that we should like to stretch out over the whole of time.
author: Albert Camus

quote: The world's biggest power is the youth and beauty of a woman.
author: Chanakya

quote: Beauty awakens the soul to act.
author: Dante Alighieri

quote: A witty woman is a treasure a witty beauty is a power.
author: George Meredith

quote: Think of all the beauty still left around you and be happy.
author: Anne Frank

quote: Beauty is a manifestation of secret natural laws, which otherwise would have been hidden from us forever.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: Beauty is all very well at first sight but who ever looks at it when it has been in the house three days?
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: Beauty has a lot to do with character.
author: Kevyn Aucoin

quote: There is no definition of beauty, but when you can see someone's spirit coming through, something unexplainable, that's beautiful to me.
author: Liv Tyler

quote: For me the greatest beauty always lies in the greatest clarity.
author: Gotthold Ephraim Lessing

quote: Since love grows within you, so beauty grows. For love is the beauty of the soul.
author: Saint Augustine

quote: I define nothing. Not beauty, not patriotism. I take each thing as it is, without prior rules about what it should be.
author: Bob Dylan

quote: Beauty is worse than wine, it intoxicates both the holder and beholder.
author: Aldous Huxley

quote: Beauty in things exists in the mind which contemplates them.
author: David Hume

quote: I do not have much patience with a thing of beauty that must be explained to be understood. If it does need additional interpretation by someone other than the creator, then I question whether it has fulfilled its purpose.
author: Charlie Chaplin

quote: I don't think of all the misery but of the beauty that still remains.
author: Anne Frank

quote: Beauty is not caused. It is.
author: Emily Dickinson

quote: Beauty is truth's smile when she beholds her own face in a perfect mirror.
author: Rabindranath Tagore

quote: Beauty is everywhere a welcome guest.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quote: It is amazing how complete is the delusion that beauty is goodness.
author: Leo Tolstoy

quote: A mode of conduct, a standard of courage, discipline, fortitude and integrity can do a great deal to make a woman beautiful.
author: Jacqueline Bisset

quote: Beauty, n: the power by which a woman charms a lover and terrifies a husband.
author: Ambrose Bierce

quote: Beauty doesn't need ornaments. Softness can't bear the weight of ornaments.
author: Munshi Premchand

quote: Beauty is in the heart of the beholder.
author: H. G. Wells

quote: Let us live for the beauty of our own reality.
author: Charles Lamb

quote: Every year of my life I grow more convinced that it is wisest and best to fix our attention on the beautiful and the good, and dwell as little as possible on the evil and the false.
author: Richard Cecil

quote: Beauty is the promise of happiness.
author: Edmund Burke

quote: We live in a wonderful world that is full of beauty, charm and adventure. There is no end to the adventures that we can have if only we seek them with our eyes open.
author: Jawaharlal Nehru

quote: Imagination disposes of everything it creates beauty, justice, and happiness, which are everything in this world.
author: Blaise Pascal

quote: A women's greatest asset is her beauty.
author: Alex Comfort

quote: Beauty is power a smile is its sword.
author: John Ray

quote: Beauty itself is but the sensible image of the Infinite.
author: Francis Bacon

quote: If you look closely at a tree you'll notice it's knots and dead branches, just like our bodies. What we learn is that beauty and imperfection go together wonderfully.
author: Matthew Fox

quote: Beauty is ever to the lonely mind a shadow fleeting she is never plain. She is a visitor who leaves behind the gift of grief, the souvenir of pain.
author: Christopher Morley

quote: Beauty is only temporary, but your mind lasts you a lifetime.
author: Alicia Machado

quote: Beauty is a fragile gift.
author: Ovid

quote: Beauty saves. Beauty heals. Beauty motivates. Beauty unites. Beauty returns us to our origins, and here lies the ultimate act of saving, of healing, of overcoming dualism.
author: Matthew Fox

quote: In every man's heart there is a secret nerve that answers to the vibrations of beauty.
author: Christopher Morley

quote: Love built on beauty, soon as beauty, dies.
author: John Donne

quote: I don't need plastic in my body to validate me as a woman.
author: Courtney Love

quote: I gave my beauty and my youth to men. I am going to give my wisdom and experience to animals.
author: Brigitte Bardot

quote: The problem with beauty is that it's like being born rich and getting poorer.
author: Joan Collins

quote: In youth and beauty, wisdom is but rare!
author: Homer

quote: Heat cannot be separated from fire, or beauty from The Eternal.
author: Dante Alighieri

quote: Having inner beauty is something you develop on your own, and I like to think I have that.
author: Cindy Margolis

quote: Beauty is less important than quality.
author: Eugene Ormandy

quote: There is a kind of beauty in imperfection.
author: Conrad Hall

quote: Beauty is variable, ugliness is constant.
author: Douglas Horton

quote: 'Handsome' means many things to many people. If people consider me handsome, I feel flattered - and have my parents to thank for it. Realistically, it doesn't hurt to be good-looking, especially in this business.
author: Richard Chamberlain

quote: My mother always called me an ugly weed, so I never was aware of anything until I was older. Plain girls should have someone telling them they are beautiful. Sometimes this works miracles.
author: Hedy Lamarr

quote: Zest is the secret of all beauty. There is no beauty that is attractive without zest.
author: Christian Dior

quote: Beauty is our weapon against nature by it we make objects, giving them limit, symmetry, proportion. Beauty halts and freezes the melting flux of nature.
author: Camille Paglia

quote: Beauty is whatever gives joy.
author: Edna St. Vincent Millay

quote: There is no personal achievement in being born beautiful.
author: Loretta Young

quote: The love of beauty in its multiple forms is the noblest gift of the human cerebrum.
author: Alexis Carrel

quote: Beauty is the first present nature gives to women and the first it takes away.
author: Fay Weldon

quote: Some guys say beauty is only skin deep. But when you walk into a party, you don't see somebody's brain. The initial contact has to be the sniffing.
author: James Caan

quote: We are learning, too, that the love of beauty is one of Nature's greatest healers.
author: Ellsworth Huntington

quote: I sincerely feel that beauty largely comes from within.
author: Christy Turlington

quote: There is no cosmetic for beauty like happiness.
author: Maria Mitchell

quote: Even in the centuries which appear to us to be the most monstrous and foolish, the immortal appetite for beauty has always found satisfaction.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: You can only perceive real beauty in a person as they get older.
author: Anouk Aimee

quote: Inner beauty should be the most important part of improving one's self.
author: Priscilla Presley

quote: What beauty is, I know not, though it adheres to many things.
author: Albrecht Durer

quote: Though beauty gives you a weird sense of entitlement, it's rather frightening and threatening to have others ascribe such importance to something you know you're just renting for a while.
author: Candice Bergen

quote: Things are beautiful if you love them.
author: Jean Anouilh

quote: The real sin against life is to abuse and destroy beauty, even one's own even more, one's own, for that has been put in our care and we are responsible for its well-being.
author: Katherine Anne Porter

quote: Real beauty knocks you a little bit off kilter.
author: David Byrne

quote: Integrity reveals beauty.
author: Thomas Leonard

quote: Goodness is beauty in the best estate.
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: Our hearts were drunk with a beauty Our eyes could never see.
author: George William Russell

quote: Like charity, I believe glamour should begin at home.
author: Loretta Young

quote: How goodness heightens beauty!
author: Milan Kundera

quote: Because beauty isn't enough, there must be something more.
author: Eva Herzigova

quote: Taking joy in living is a woman's best cosmetic.
author: Rosalind Russell

quote: Without realizing it, the individual composes his life according to the laws of beauty even in times of greatest distress.
author: Milan Kundera

quote: I can't live without my beauty products. I love to be in my bathroom with my candles lit, morning, noon and night. I like taking hot baths and hot showers, using my body scrubs and lotions.
author: Traci Bingham

quote: I'd like to grow up and be beautiful. I know it doesn't matter, but it doesn't hurt.
author: Kirsten Dunst

quote: My dad had this philosophy that if you tell children they're beautiful and wonderful then they believe it, and they will be. So I never thought I was unattractive. But I was never one of the girls at school who had lots of boyfriends.
author: Emily Mortimer

quote: O human beauty, what a dream art thou, that we should cast our life and hopes away on thee!
author: Barry Cornwall

quote: When everything else physical and mental seems to diminish, the appreciation of beauty is on the increase.
author: Bernard Berenson

quote: I was not a good-lookin' girl. I was extremely skinny. I wasn't pretty. I wasn't cool.
author: Celine Dion

quote: Beauty is only skin deep.
author: Thomas Overbury

quote: You can't really say what is beautiful about a place, but the image of the place will remain vividly with you.
author: Tadao Ando

quote: The plainer the dress, the greater luster does beauty appear.
author: Edward F. Halifax

quote: Real beauty is to be true to oneself. That's what makes me feel good.
author: Laetitia Casta

quote: It's sad when girls think they don't have anything going on except being pretty.
author: Keri Russell

quote: There is hope and a kind of beauty in there somewhere, if you look for it.
author: H. R. Giger

quote: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quote: The beauty of a woman is not in a facial mode but the true beauty in a woman is reflected in her soul. It is the caring that she lovingly gives the passion that she shows. The beauty of a woman grows with the passing years.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: Our task must be to free ourselves by widening our circle of compassion to embrace all living creatures and the whole of nature and its beauty.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: The beauty of a woman must be seen from in her eyes, because that is the doorway to her heart, the place where love resides.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: It is time for parents to teach young people early on that in diversity there is beauty and there is strength.
author: Maya Angelou

quote: Education is the best friend. An educated person is respected everywhere. Education beats the beauty and the youth.
author: Chanakya

quote: The beauty of a woman is not in the clothes she wears, the figure that she carries or the way she combs her hair.
author: Audrey Hepburn

quote: Wisdom I know is social. She seeks her fellows. But Beauty is jealous, and illy bears the presence of a rival.
author: Thomas Jefferson

quote: Beauty of whatever kind, in its supreme development, invariably excites the sensitive soul to tears.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: There is something terribly morbid in the modern sympathy with pain. One should sympathise with the colour, the beauty, the joy of life. The less said about life's sores the better.
author: Oscar Wilde

quote: Yesterday we obeyed kings and bent our necks before emperors. But today we kneel only to truth, follow only beauty, and obey only love.
author: Khalil Gibran

quote: Love is the beauty of the soul.
author: Saint Augustine

quote: Beauty is how you feel inside, and it reflects in your eyes. It is not something physical.
author: Sophia Loren

quote: Beauty without expression is boring.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: Beauty without grace is the hook without the bait.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: We find delight in the beauty and happiness of children that makes the heart too big for the body.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: It is cruel, you know, that music should be so beautiful. It has the beauty of loneliness of pain: of strength and freedom. The beauty of disappointment and never-satisfied love. The cruel beauty of nature and everlasting beauty of monotony.
author: Benjamin Britten

quote: Everybody needs beauty as well as bread, places to play in and pray in, where nature may heal and give strength to body and soul.
author: John Muir

quote: Beauty is an outward gift, which is seldom despised, except by those to whom it has been refused.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: As we grow old, the beauty steals inward.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quote: A healthful hunger for a great idea is the beauty and blessedness of life.
author: Jean Ingelow

quote: Imperfection is beauty, madness is genius and it's better to be absolutely ridiculous than absolutely boring.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: Beauty and femininity are ageless and can't be contrived, and glamour, although the manufacturers won't like this, cannot be manufactured. Not real glamour it's based on femininity.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: When I am working on a problem, I never think about beauty but when I have finished, if the solution is not beautiful, I know it is wrong.
author: R. Buckminster Fuller

quote: Beauty is a short-lived tyranny.
author: Socrates

quote: Beauty is the bait which with delight allures man to enlarge his kind.
author: Socrates

quote: Loneliness adds beauty to life. It puts a special burn on sunsets and makes night air smell better.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: The perception of beauty is a moral test.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: For every moment of triumph, for every instance of beauty, many souls must be trampled.
author: Hunter S. Thompson

quote: Alas! how little does the memory of these human inhabitants enhance the beauty of the landscape!
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: Poetry is the rhythmical creation of beauty in words.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: Let the beauty of what you love be what you do.
author: Rumi

quote: Only on paper has humanity yet achieved glory, beauty, truth, knowledge, virtue, and abiding love.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: Beauty is a short-lived tyranny.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: 'Beauty is truth, truth beauty,' - that is all ye know on earth, and all ye need to know.
author: John Keats

quote: It is not sufficient to see and to know the beauty of a work. We must feel and be affected by it.
author: Voltaire

quote: Enlightened leadership is spiritual if we understand spirituality not as some kind of religious dogma or ideology but as the domain of awareness where we experience values like truth, goodness, beauty, love and compassion, and also intuition, creativity, insight and focused attention.
author: Deepak Chopra

quote: Anything in any way beautiful derives its beauty from itself and asks nothing beyond itself. Praise is no part of it, for nothing is made worse or better by praise.
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: Grace is the beauty of form under the influence of freedom.
author: Friedrich Schiller

quote: I would define, in brief, the poetry of words as the rhythmical creation of Beauty.
author: Edgar Allan Poe

quote: I am a thing of beauty.
author: Frank Sinatra

quote: The beauty, the poetry of the fear in their eyes. I didn't mind going to jail for, what, five, six hours? It was absolutely worth it.
author: Johnny Depp

quote: Character contributes to beauty. It fortifies a woman as her youth fades. A mode of conduct, a standard of courage, discipline, fortitude, and integrity can do a great deal to make a woman beautiful.
author: Jacqueline Bisset

quote: Far away there in the sunshine are my highest aspirations. I may not reach them, but I can look up and see their beauty, believe in them, and try to follow where they lead.
author: Louisa May Alcott

quote: It is not so much for its beauty that the forest makes a claim upon men's hearts, as for that subtle something, that quality of air that emanation from old trees, that so wonderfully changes and renews a weary spirit.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quote: By plucking her petals, you do not gather the beauty of the flower.
author: Rabindranath Tagore

quote: Beauty is the greatest seducer of man.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: I think permitting the game to become too physical takes away a little bit of the beauty.
author: John Wooden

quote: Be sure what you want and be sure about yourself. Fashion is not just beauty, it's about good attitude. You have to believe in yourself and be strong.
author: Adriana Lima

quote: A lot of us grow up and we grow out of the literal interpretation that we get when we're children, but we bear the scars all our life. Whether they're scars of beauty or scars of ugliness, it's pretty much in the eye of the beholder.
author: Stephen King

quote: If truth is beauty, how come no one has their hair done in the library?
author: Lily Tomlin

quote: Everyone has their own insecurities, regardless of how you look or how people perceive you, but sometimes people give their insecurities too much power. Defining beauty is simply a matter of opinion. For me, real beauty has very little to do with the structure of someone's face or body.
author: Devon Aoki

quote: Anyone who keeps the ability to see beauty never grows old.
author: Franz Kafka

quote: It was one of those evenings when men feel that truth, goodness and beauty are one. In the morning, when they commit their discovery to paper, when others read it written there, it looks wholly ridiculous.
author: Aldous Huxley

quote: It's not beauty but fine qualities, my girl, that keep a husband.
author: Euripides

quote: What would be ugly in a garden constitutes beauty in a mountain.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: Do you know the difference between a beautiful woman and a charming one? A beauty is a woman you notice, a charmer is one who notices you.
author: Adlai E. Stevenson

quote: Art is not the application of a canon of beauty but what the instinct and the brain can conceive beyond any canon. When we love a woman we don't start measuring her limbs.
author: Pablo Picasso

quote: I'm just glad I was able to return to some of that innocence and beauty I had as a child when I started my own family, and my children brought me back some of that spirit.
author: Angelina Jolie

quote: Great perils have this beauty, that they bring to light the fraternity of strangers.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: The books that help you most are those which make you think that most. The hardest way of learning is that of easy reading but a great book that comes from a great thinker is a ship of thought, deep freighted with truth and beauty.
author: Pablo Neruda

quote: The ideal and the beautiful are identical the ideal corresponds to the idea, and beauty to form hence idea and substance are cognate.
author: Victor Hugo

quote: Whatever you may look like, marry a man your own age - as your beauty fades, so will his eyesight.
author: Phyllis Diller

quote: What a man does for pay is of little significance. What he is, as a sensitive instrument responsive to the world's beauty, is everything!
author: H. P. Lovecraft

quote: Celibacy is not just a matter of not having sex. It is a way of admiring a person for their humanity, maybe even for their beauty.
author: Timothy Radcliffe

quote: The beauty is that through disappointment you can gain clarity, and with clarity comes conviction and true originality.
author: Conan O'Brien

quote: Endurance is nobler than strength, and patience than beauty.
author: John Ruskin

quote: Secrecy is the element of all goodness even virtue, even beauty is mysterious.
author: Thomas Carlyle

quote: Art can never exist without naked beauty displayed.
author: William Blake

quote: Exuberance is beauty.
author: William Blake

quote: It's a good thing that beauty is only skin deep, or I'd be rotten to the core.
author: Phyllis Diller

quote: Sexiness wears thin after a while and beauty fades, but to be married to a man who makes you laugh every day, ah, now that's a real treat.
author: Joanne Woodward

quote: Photography records the gamut of feelings written on the human face, the beauty of the earth and skies that man has inherited, and the wealth and confusion man has created. It is a major force in explaining man to man.
author: Edward Steichen

quote: Most sets of values would give rise to universes that, although they might be very beautiful, would contain no one able to wonder at that beauty.
author: Stephen Hawking

quote: Love is the attempt to form a friendship inspired by beauty.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quote: There are no better cosmetics than a severe temperance and purity, modesty and humility, a gracious temper and calmness of spirit and there is no true beauty without the signatures of these graces in the very countenance.
author: Arthur Helps

quote: Beauty is an ecstasy it is as simple as hunger. There is really nothing to be said about it. It is like the perfume of a rose: you can smell it and that is all.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: I can barely conceive of a type of beauty in which there is no Melancholy.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: That which you create in beauty and goodness and truth lives on for all time to come. Don't spend your life accumulating material objects that will only turn to dust and ashes.
author: Denis Waitley

quote: A person however learned and qualified in his life's work in whom gratitude is absent, is devoid of that beauty of character which makes personality fragrant.
author: Hazrat Inayat Khan

quote: Facts which at first seem improbable will, even on scant explanation, drop the cloak which has hidden them and stand forth in naked and simple beauty.
author: Galileo Galilei

quote: Beauty in distress is much the most affecting beauty.
author: Edmund Burke

quote: The beauty of independence, departure, actions that rely on themselves.
author: Walt Whitman

quote: Beauty makes idiots sad and wise men merry.
author: George Jean Nathan

quote: Look up, laugh loud, talk big, keep the color in your cheek and the fire in your eye, adorn your person, maintain your health, your beauty and your animal spirits.
author: William Hazlitt

quote: Should you shield the canyons from the windstorms you would never see the true beauty of their carvings.
author: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

quote: The best part of beauty is that which no picture can express.
author: Francis Bacon

quote: When I say that human beings are just gene machines, one shouldn't put too much emphasis on the word 'just.' There is a very great deal of complication, and indeed beauty in being a gene machine.
author: Richard Dawkins

quote: It is the addition of strangeness to beauty that constitutes the romantic character in art.
author: Walter Hagen

quote: Beauty may be skin deep, but ugly goes clear to the bone.
author: Redd Foxx

quote: Beauty is in the eye of the beer holder.
author: Kinky Friedman

quote: Teach us that wealth is not elegance, that profusion is not magnificence, that splendor is not beauty.
author: Benjamin Disraeli

quote: I also became close to nature, and am now able to appreciate the beauty with which this world is endowed.
author: James Dean

quote: In marriage do thou be wise: prefer the person before money, virtue before beauty, the mind before the body then thou hast a wife, a friend, a companion, a second self.
author: William Penn

quote: At fifteen, beauty and talent do not exist there can only be promise of the coming woman.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: Children, dear and loving children, can alone console a woman for the loss of her beauty.
author: Honore de Balzac

quote: If in my youth I had realized that the sustaining splendour of beauty of with which I was in love would one day flood back into my heart, there to ignite a flame that would torture me without end, how gladly would I have put out the light in my eyes.
author: Michelangelo

quote: A day spent without the sight or sound of beauty, the contemplation of mystery, or the search of truth or perfection is a poverty-stricken day and a succession of such days is fatal to human life.
author: Lewis Mumford

quote: At some point in life the world's beauty becomes enough. You don't need to photograph, paint or even remember it. It is enough.
author: Toni Morrison

quote: Beauty is about perception, not about make-up. I think the beginning of all beauty is knowing and liking oneself. You can't put on make-up, or dress yourself, or do you hair with any sort of fun or joy if you're doing it from a position of correction.
author: Kevyn Aucoin

quote: That's why I began doing makeup in the first place: I was hoping that through helping people see the beauty in themselves, I could try and find it in me.
author: Kevyn Aucoin

quote: Beauty is only skin deep. I think what's really important is finding a balance of mind, body and spirit.
author: Jennifer Lopez

quote: When I tried to play something and screwed up, I'd hear some other note that would come into play. Then I started trying different things to find the beauty in it.
author: Dimebag Darrell

quote: The most common error made in matters of appearance is the belief that one should disdain the superficial and let the true beauty of one's soul shine through. If there are places on your body where this is a possibility, you are not attractive - you are leaking.
author: Charles Lamb

quote: The terrifying and edible beauty of Art Nouveau architecture.
author: Salvador Dali

quote: O, thou art fairer than the evening air clad in the beauty of a thousand stars.
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: Through loyalty to the past, our mind refuses to realize that tomorrow's joy is possible only if today's makes way for it that each wave owes the beauty of its line only to the withdrawal of the preceding one.
author: Andre Gide

quote: There is no excellent beauty that hath not some strangeness in the proportion.
author: Francis Bacon

quote: Although beauty may be in the eye of the beholder, the feeling of being beautiful exists solely in the mind of the beheld.
author: Martha Beck

quote: Beauty, to me, is about being comfortable in your own skin. That, or a kick-ass red lipstick.
author: Gwyneth Paltrow

quote: The human mind is capable of excitement without the application of gross and violent stimulants and he must have a very faint perception of its beauty and dignity who does not know this.
author: William Wordsworth

quote: Beauty deprived of its proper foils and adjuncts ceases to be enjoyed as beauty, just as light deprived of all shadows ceases to be enjoyed as light.
author: John Ruskin

quote: The kind of beauty I want most is the hard-to-get kind that comes from within - strength, courage, dignity.
author: Ruby Dee

quote: Beauty for some provides escape, who gain a happiness in eyeing the gorgeous buttocks of the ape or Autumn sunsets exquisitely dying.
author: Langston Hughes

quote: To give pain is the tyranny to make happy, the true empire of beauty.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: The beauty of the world, which is so soon to perish, has two edges, one of laughter, one of anguish, cutting the heart asunder.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: Every beauty which is seen here by persons of perception resembles more than anything else that celestial source from which we all are come.
author: Michelangelo

quote: Beauty always promises, but never gives anything.
author: Simone Weil

quote: To look almost pretty is an acquisition of higher delight to a girl who has been looking plain for the first fifteen years of her life than a beauty from her cradle can ever receive.
author: Jane Austen

quote: Poets say science takes away from the beauty of the stars - mere globs of gas atoms. I, too, can see the stars on a desert night, and feel them. But do I see less or more?
author: Richard P. Feynman

quote: We especially need imagination in science. It is not all mathematics, nor all logic, but it is somewhat beauty and poetry.
author: Maria Montessori

quote: The architect should strive continually to simplify the ensemble of the rooms should then be carefully considered that comfort and utility may go hand in hand with beauty.
author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quote: It is art that makes life, makes interest, makes importance... and I know of no substitute whatever for the force and beauty of its process.
author: Henry James

quote: It is dangerous for mortal beauty, or terrestrial virtue, to be examined by too strong a light. The torch of Truth shows much that we cannot, and all that we would not, see.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: I don't like people who have never fallen or stumbled. Their virtue is lifeless and it isn't of much value. Life hasn't revealed its beauty to them.
author: Boris Pasternak

quote: Taught from infancy that beauty is woman's sceptre, the mind shapes itself to the body, and roaming round its gilt cage, only seeks to adorn its prison.
author: Mary Wollstonecraft

quote: Humanism was not wrong in thinking that truth, beauty, liberty, and equality are of infinite value, but in thinking that man can get them for himself without grace.
author: Simone Weil

quote: Don't get me wrong, I admire elegance and have an appreciation of the finer things in life. But to me, beauty lies in simplicity.
author: Mark Hyman

quote: Beauty is the disinterested one, without which the ancient world refused to understand itself, a word which both imperceptibly and yet unmistakably has bid farewell to our new world, a world of interests, leaving it to its own avarice and sadness.
author: Hans Urs von Balthasar

quote: Courtesy is a silver lining around the dark clouds of civilization it is the best part of refinement and in many ways, an art of heroic beauty in the vast gallery of man's cruelty and baseness.
author: Bryant H. McGill

quote: An artist is an artist only because of his exquisite sense of beauty, a sense which shows him intoxicating pleasures, but which at the same time implies and contains an equally exquisite sense of all deformities and all disproportion.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: San Francisco is a mad city - inhabited for the most part by perfectly insane people whose women are of a remarkable beauty.
author: Rudyard Kipling

quote: Beauty is also submitted to the taste of time, so a beautiful woman from the Belle Epoch is not exactly the perfect beauty of today, so beauty is something that changes with time.
author: Karl Lagerfeld

quote: A whopping 89 percent of buyers start their home search online. How your house looks online is the modern equivalent of 'curb appeal.' Rent a wide-angle lens and good lighting, get rid of your clutter and post at least eight great photos to win the beauty contest.
author: Barbara Corcoran

quote: Sex and beauty are inseparable, like life and consciousness. And the intelligence which goes with sex and beauty, and arises out of sex and beauty, is intuition.
author: David Herbert Lawrence

quote: There's a beauty to wisdom and experience that cannot be faked. It's impossible to be mature without having lived.
author: Amy Grant

quote: Praise or blame has but a momentary effect on the man whose love of beauty in the abstract makes him a severe critic on his own works.
author: John Keats

quote: Youth is happy because it has the ability to see beauty. Anyone who keeps the ability to see beauty never grows old.
author: Franz Kafka

quote: It would be difficult for me not to conclude that the most perfect type of masculine beauty is Satan, as portrayed by Milton.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: I am little concerned with beauty or perfection. I don't care for the great centuries. All I care about is life, struggle, intensity.
author: Emile Zola

quote: Nonsense and beauty have close connections.
author: E. M. Forster

quote: Beauty ought to look a little surprised: it is the emotion that best suits her face. The beauty who does not look surprised, who accepts her position as her due - she reminds us too much of a prima donna.
author: E. M. Forster

quote: If we do not permit the earth to produce beauty and joy, it will in the end not produce food, either.
author: Joseph Wood Krutch

quote: I don't want to be perfect, but I do want to be a role model. My mom always tells me that imperfections equal beauty. All of us are imperfect.
author: Miley Cyrus

quote: To me, teamwork is the beauty of our sport, where you have five acting as one. You become selfless.
author: Mike Krzyzewski

quote: I decided that if I could paint that flower in a huge scale, you could not ignore its beauty.
author: Georgia O'Keeffe

quote: What the imagination seizes as beauty must be truth.
author: John Keats

quote: With a great poet the sense of Beauty overcomes every other consideration, or rather obliterates all consideration.
author: John Keats

quote: In chess one cannot control everything. Sometimes a game takes an unexpected turn, in which beauty begins to emerge. Both players are always instrumental in this.
author: Vladimir Kramnik

quote: No spring nor summer beauty hath such grace as I have seen in one autumnal face.
author: John Donne

quote: I believe that children are our future. Teach them well and let them lead the way. Show them all the beauty they possess inside.
author: Whitney Houston

quote: The lover knows much more about absolute good and universal beauty than any logician or theologian, unless the latter, too, be lovers in disguise.
author: George Santayana

quote: It is well known that Beauty does not look with a good grace on the timid advances of Humour.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: There is certainly no absolute standard of beauty. That precisely is what makes its pursuit so interesting.
author: John Kenneth Galbraith

quote: There is great beauty in going through life without anxiety or fear. Half our fears are baseless, and the other half discreditable.
author: Christian Nestell Bovee

quote: Grace in women has more effect than beauty.
author: William Hazlitt

quote: There is nothing that makes its way more directly into the soul than beauty.
author: Joseph Addison

quote: Competence, like truth, beauty, and contact lenses, is in the eye of the beholder.
author: Laurence J. Peter

quote: People say I'm extravagant because I want to be surrounded by beauty. But tell me, who wants to be surrounded by garbage?
author: Imelda Marcos

quote: Grace is in garments, in movements, in manners beauty in the nude, and in forms. This is true of bodies but when we speak of feelings, beauty is in their spirituality, and grace in their moderation.
author: Joseph Joubert

quote: I think everybody can agree that you can hear a certain song and it will put you in a certain mood, and that's just the beauty of music and I am so inspired by that.
author: Shaun White

quote: Paris is one of the most beautiful places in all the world. Unfortunately, I was so homesick I couldn't appreciate its beauty.
author: Tyra Banks

quote: The human soul needs actual beauty more than bread.
author: David Herbert Lawrence

quote: For the man sound of body and serene of mind there is no such thing as bad weather every day has its beauty, and storms which whip the blood do but make it pulse more vigorously.
author: George Gissing

quote: Who would not give up wit for power and beauty?
author: Mason Cooley

quote: Enhance and intensify one's vision of that synthesis of truth and beauty which is the highest and deepest reality.
author: Ovid

quote: The beautiful seems right by force of beauty, and the feeble wrong because of weakness.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: What is man's ultimate direction in life? It is to look for love, truth, virtue, and beauty.
author: Shinichi Suzuki

quote: Beauty is desired in order that it may be befouled not for its own sake, but for the joy brought by the certainty of profaning it.
author: Tom Stoppard

quote: The moment you cheat for the sake of beauty, you know you're an artist.
author: David Hockney

quote: A thing is right when it tends to preserve the integrity, stability and beauty of the biotic community. It is wrong when it tends otherwise.
author: Aldo Leopold

quote: A bad manner spoils everything, even reason and justice a good one supplies everything, gilds a No, sweetens a truth, and adds a touch of beauty to old age itself.
author: Baltasar Gracian

quote: Beauty is the lover's gift.
author: William Congreve

quote: There is in true beauty, as in courage, something which narrow souls cannot dare to admire.
author: William Congreve

quote: A woman can be very beautiful and an ideal model and she will photograph incredibly well, but she'll appear in film and it won't work. What works is some fusion of physical beauty with some mental field or whatever you call it. I don't know.
author: Oliver Stone

quote: The ideal beauty is a fugitive which is never found.
author: Joan Rivers

quote: Wisdom is the abstract of the past, but beauty is the promise of the future.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes

quote: Our scientific age demands that we provide definitions, measurements, and statistics in order to be taken seriously. Yet most of the important things in life cannot be precisely defined or measured. Can we define or measure love, beauty, friendship, or decency, for example?
author: Dennis Prager

quote: No matter what a woman's appearance may be, it will be used to undermine what she is saying and taken to individualize - as her personal problem - observations she makes about the beauty myth in society.
author: Naomi Wolf

quote: Vampires have always held a very seductive kind of lore and have always been some variety of attractive, whether it's attractiveness that's born of just the physical attributes that they have - this kind of ethereal beauty or translucent pallor - or whether it is more to do with the way they carry themselves.
author: Colin Farrell

quote: For what the horse does under compulsion, as Simon also observes, is done without understanding and there is no beauty in it either, any more than if one should whip and spur a dancer.
author: Xenophon

quote: I might have some character traits that some might see as innocence or naive. That's because I discovered peace and happiness in my soul. And with this knowledge, I also see the beauty of human life.
author: Tobey Maguire

quote: After all, it is the divinity within that makes the divinity without and I have been more fascinated by a woman of talent and intelligence, though deficient in personal charms, than I have been by the most regular beauty.
author: Washington Irving

quote: Do not try to push your way through to the front ranks of your profession do not run after distinctions and rewards but do your utmost to find an entry into the world of beauty.
author: Sydney Smith

quote: All cities are mad: but the madness is gallant. All cities are beautiful: but the beauty is grim.
author: Christopher Morley

quote: People think that if you look fairly reasonable, you can't possibly act, and as I only care about acting, I think beauty can be a great handicap.
author: Vivien Leigh

quote: Romance and novel paint beauty in colors more charming than nature, and describe a happiness that humans never taste. How deceptive and destructive are those pictures of consummate bliss!
author: Oliver Goldsmith

quote: Always think of what is useful and not what is beautiful. Beauty will come of its own accord.
author: Nikolai Gogol

quote: Beauty, like ice, our footing does betray Who can tread sure on the smooth, slippery way: Pleased with the surface, we glide swiftly on, And see the dangers that we cannot shun.
author: John Dryden

quote: Filipinos want beauty. I have to look beautiful so that the poor Filipinos will have a star to look at from their slums.
author: Imelda Marcos

quote: I have been overcome by the beauty and richness of our life together, those early mornings setting out, those evenings gleaming with rivers and lakes below us, still holding the last light.
author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

quote: I was always reading those beauty magazines and wanting to become this unattainable thing.
author: Jennifer Aniston

quote: I love Rauschenberg. I love that he created a turning point in visual history, that he redefined the idea of beauty, that he combined painting, sculpture, photography, and everyday life with such gall, and that he was interested in, as he put it, 'the ability to conceive failure as progress.'
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: Abstraction brings the world into more complex, variable relations it can extract beauty, alternative topographies, ugliness, and intense actualities from seeming nothingness.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: In such ugly times, the only true protest is beauty.
author: Phil Ochs

quote: During the 80s and 90s, we all became consumed with ourselves. In the 21st century, we've come back to simpler times. People are struggling economically and this has forced them to scale back the material aspects of their lives and realise the beauty of finding the simple joy in being with the people we love.
author: Julia Roberts

quote: Beauty attracts us men but if, like an armed magnet it is pointed, beside, with gold and silver, it attracts with tenfold power.
author: Jean Paul

quote: So much has been said and sung of beautiful young girls, why doesn't somebody wake up to the beauty of old women.
author: Harriet Beecher Stowe

quote: In LA, where I live, it's all about perfectionism. Beauty is now defined by your bones sticking out of your decolletage. For that to be the standard is really perilous for women.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: Beauty is now defined by your bones sticking out of your decolletage. For that to be the standard is really perilous for women.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: Beauty will be convulsive or will not be at all.
author: Andre Breton

quote: The pleasure we derive from the representation of the present is due, not only to the beauty it can be clothed in, but also to its essential quality of being the present.
author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: Poetry lifts the veil from the hidden beauty of the world, and makes familiar objects be as if they were not familiar.
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

quote: Obscenity, which is ever blasphemy against the divine beauty in life, is a monster for which the corruption of society forever brings forth new food, which it devours in secret.
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

quote: Everybody know, I don't do no promoting. I don't ever have to promote nothing, that's the beauty of Lil Wayne.
author: Lil Wayne

quote: Whenever, at a party, I have been in the mood to study fools, I have always looked for a great beauty: they always gather round her like flies around a fruit stall.
author: Jean Paul

author: Helen Rowland

quote: The key to education is the experience of beauty.
author: Friedrich Schiller

quote: Aging has a wonderful beauty and we should have respect for that.

author: Charles Baudelaire

quote: The study of beauty is a duel in which the artist cries with terror before being defeated.

quote: Beauty is the sole ambition, the exclusive goal of Taste.

author: Lord Chesterfield

quote: Beauty is that which is simultaneously attractive and sublime.

author: George Byron

author: Pope Paul VI

author: Nikos Kazantzakis

author: David Hume

author: Imelda Marcos

quote: Depression opens the door to beauty of some kind.

quote: Somehow a bachelor never quite gets over the idea that he is a thing of beauty and a boy forever.
author: Helen Rowland

quote: Pay attention to the beauty surrounding you.

author: Paul Getty

author: St. Jerome

quote: Younger women have no problem in reconciling beauty with ambitions as a professional woman.
author: Camille Paglia

quote: It seems like the chaos of this world is accelerating, but so is the beauty in the consciousness of more and more people.
author: Anthony Kiedis

author: Plautus

author: Vernon Howard

quote: I would like to say to people, open your eyes and find beauty where you normally don't expect it.

quote: Shame, like beauty, is often in the eye of the beholder.

author: Julie Burchill

author: Julie Burchill

author: Julie Burchill

author: Julie Burchill

author: David Allan Coe

quote: One of the things that people don't realize is that that natural beauty, those recreational forests, they have an economic development impact for the state as well.

quote: Black beauty - he's a dark horse.

quote: People don't associate red hair, pale skin, and freckles with beauty.

quote: Physical beauty is such a strange thing.

quote: I was kind of a jock in school. Beauty wasn't something I spent a lot of time on.

quote: I'm very accepting with my age. It's like notches on your belt: experience, wisdom, and a different kind of beauty. There comes a day when you've become comfortable in your skin.

quote: Beauty is a radiance that originates from within and comes from inner security and strong character.

quote: I tried for a while to be an agricultural worker and was hopelessly bored. I would stand around in heaps of manure and sing about the beauty of the work I wasn't doing.
author: Theodore Bikel

quote: Beauty fades! I just turned 29, so I probably don't have that many good years left in me.
author: Gwyneth Paltrow

quote: Beauty, to me is about being comfortable in your own skin.
author: Gwyneth Paltrow

author: Sloane Crosley

quote: Beauty can come in strange forms.

quote: Well I've written four beauty books as well.
author: Joan Collins

author: Mario Batali

quote: I think we have become obsessed with beauty and personally I'm really saddened by the way women mutilate their faces today in search of that.
author: Halle Berry

quote: Beauty, more than bitterness, makes the heart break.
author: Sara Teasdale

quote: I thought to be feminine was to give in to straight culture, or the beauty standard, but in my heart I had a flair for fashion and style. They were passions I kept secret because I didn't understand I could love clothes and hair and makeup and still like girls.
author: Beth Ditto

author: Beth Ditto

quote: She gave up beauty in her tender youth, gave all her hope and joy and pleasant ways she covered up her eyes lest they should gaze on vanity, and chose the bitter truth.
author: Christina Rossetti

quote: Beauty is first and foremost an emotion.

quote: The beauty that addresses itself to the eyes is only the spell of the moment the eye of the body is not always that of the soul.
author: George Sand

quote: The trick of this thing and the beauty of this thing is that it's a cowboy movie first and then stuff happens. author: Harrison Ford

quote: With guys I revere, like Marcus Garvey or Malcolm X, their look is less about style than purpose and the expression of beauty. It wasn't just about being noticed, you know?

quote: Every man who has shown the world the way to beauty, to true culture, has been a rebel, a 'universal' without patriotism, without home, who has found his people everywhere.
author: Chaim Potok

author: Jane Smiley

author: Jennifer Garner

quote: I know it sounds a bit corny, but I do think that beauty and sexiness come from within.
